dedupe_keys.name: risk based stormwater fragility curves for urbanized coastal flooding r script

description: Ashish Shrestha at the U.S. Air Force Institute of Technology and Christopher Chini at Pacific Northwest National Laboratory publish an R script for deriving stormwater-system fragility under compound flooding. The described intensity measures combine sea-level-rise scenarios, including zero, six and ten feet, with rainfall recurrence intervals from two to one hundred years. Flood duration defines the damage state. Zenodo supplies Stormwater_fragility_v1.R, released in July 2024 and free under CC BY 4.0. The authors describe adapting the method to SWMM or similar hydrologic-hydraulic models in urban coastal catchments. Geographic coverage and simulation time step are unknown in advance and depend on the input model and are not fixed by this script. Users must generate or supply scenario outputs separately. It supports adaptation and infrastructure-risk simulation analysis; EPA-SWMM is a related catalogue model.
